fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233147/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-08 to 2026-09-30 and 2027-05-08 to 2027-09-30: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 20, second vehicle 10; First-come, First-served Season 10-01 to 10-20: 20) + notice ('Limit of two vehicles per campsite, not including trailers; $10 fee for second vehicle.'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233147 (every site STANDARD NONELECTRIC; Water Hookup 'No' or absent) + description (no hookups listed), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Two loops; most sites take a 45-ft rig, a few are 30 ft and some are tent or pop-up only. All back-ins.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233147 ('two loops with a total of 51 campsites, 27 of which can be reserved'; 'Campsites can easily accommodate large motorhomes and RVs.') + catalog (48 numbered sites; RV/Trailer max length 45 on most, 30 on 024, 042, 044, 047, 048; Driveway Entry 'Back-In' on all), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Coin showers, laundry and the store are at Sawbill Canoe Outfitters, the concessionaire, within walking distance of the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233147 ('vault toilets, a dump station, drinking water'; 'Sawbill Canoe Outfitters maintains a store with showers, laundry, fishing licenses, bait and tackle, ice, grocery and convenience items'; 'within walking distance of the campground'; amenities 'Coin Showers', 'Laundry Facilities', 'General Store'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: About 27 of the 51 sites are reservable from May 8 to September 30, booked at least 4 days ahead; the rest are first-come, and every site is first-come October 1-20.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233147 ('27 of which can be reserved (others are first-come, first-served)'; rules reservationWindow 6 Months, reservationCutOff 4 days prior to arrival, maxConsecutiveStay 14) + rates (First-come, First-served Season 10-01 to 10-20) + 2027 calendar (October all 'Not Reservable'), read 2026-11-11

note: Superior National Forest campground at the end of the Sawbill Trail, 24 miles north of Tofte, on a wooded hill above Sawbill Lake, a Boundary Waters entry point. Run by the outfitter next door, which rents canoes and issues wilderness permits. Some sites have a partial lake view through the forest. --Claude
summary: rec.gov read: 51 sites (48 in the catalog), no hookups, most 45 ft back-ins, ~27 reservable; $20 confirmed, second vehicle $10, two vehicles max; showers, laundry and store at the concessionaire next door; reservable May 8-Sep 30, first-come Oct 1-20. Season (manual) left alone; rec.gov's last night may be 10-20 against the stored 10-19. Not waterfront kept (closed canopy). Pin OK.
flags: Season provenance is manual (FS page 'May 8 - October 19', 2026-11-08), so it is not rewritten. rec.gov agrees on the opening (Peak Season from 05-08); its October first-come season runs '2027-10-01' to '2027-10-20' and the 2027 calendar lists nights through 10-20 as 'Not Reservable' (not 'Closed'), so the last night may be 10-20 rather than 10-19. Minor; left for the reviewer.

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. rec.gov: 'Some of the sites offer a partial lake view through the forest' and 'The campground sits on a hill above Sawbill Lake'. Imagery with catalog points: the west-loop front row (002/003, 005, 008, 012, 015, 018, 020, 021 at ~47.8643-47.8675,-90.8862 to -90.8867) sits 40-80 m from the shore under continuous closed conifer canopy; no open ground to the water. A partial view through forest does not make lakeview.
Fees: extra_vehicle added from the rec.gov notice ($10 second vehicle, two vehicles max not counting trailers). The federal:usfs row says extra vehicles are set per campground.
Facilities: showers, laundry and camp_store added - all at the concessionaire's store (Sawbill Canoe Outfitters) 'within walking distance', not in the campground; the facilities note says so.

Sites: rec.gov text says 51 sites, the catalog lists 48 numbered sites (002-050 without 016) plus two day-use spots; count 51 kept. About 29 are flagged reservable in the catalog against the text's 27. Five reservable sites are 30-ft; several unreservable ones carry no length.
Pin 47.86450,-90.88560 is on the campground road between site 005 and the parking lot, ~160 m north of rec.gov's facility point (47.86306,-90.88528, by the store/landing): inside the campground, OK.

Phone: none stored -> 218-663-7150 (rec.gov facility phone, the concessionaire). Website lines unchanged (rec.gov + Superior NF page; the FS page was read on 2026-11-08 for the season, not re-read here).
A rec.gov tribalDiscount rule is present (Fond du Lac, Bois Forte, Grand Portage bands); not a general discount.
